summary: Luján issued a statement after voting for two Sanders resolutions blocking arms sales to Israel, calling the Netanyahu government's war 'illegal' and saying more weapons would enable destruction and undermine a two-state solution.
quote: Equipping the Netanyahu government with hundreds of millions of dollars in additional weapons will only enable the destruction of communities, undermine the prospects for a peaceful two-state solution, and further escalate the illegal war with Iran.

summary: Luján was one of 11 senators who voted to advance Sanders' resolution requiring a State Department report on whether Israel was using US weapons to commit human rights violations in Gaza; the motion to table passed 72-11.
quote: The eleven Senators who voted to advance the resolution were Laphonza Butler (D-Calif.), Martin Heinrich (D-N.M.), Mazie Hirono (D-Hawaii), Ben Ray Lujan (D-N.M.), Ed Markey (D-Mass.), Jeff Merkley (D-Ore.), Rand Paul (R-Ky), Chris Van Hollen (D-Md.), Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.), and Sanders.
